title: Nando
text: 1. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Nando devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti || [page 063] II. 3. 9.] NĀNĀTITTHIYA-VAGGA 3. 63 etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti || || 2. Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbam jahanti || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno || lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho ti || ||
